U.note: Tins-fly-out-of-a-pile bento overlay with distinct cells, working page navigation, bag counter, Esc and outside-click close, and a strong dark roastery identity.

V.note: Clean collapsible tray with varied tile sizes, cart stepper and arrow-key navigation, but visually softer and the tray feels like a generic dropdown.

W.note: Rich bento of live widgets (bean chips, roast slider, subscription toggle, accordions, theme switch) that works well but reads more as a settings dashboard than a site menu.

X.note: Functional but sparse and small, with a tiny panel, minimal page chrome and plain tiles that underuse the bento idea.

Y.note: Handsome dark bar and widget tiles with nested accordions, but the tiles are mostly controls rather than menu destinations and the cart chip hides on mobile.

Z.note: Truly collapsible bento that reflows the same tiles between a compact icon row and a full grid with FLIP animation, working navigation, status, keyboard use and mobile layout.
